author: DJI
description:
Taking a flagship drone into Iceland’s extreme winter is the ultimate performance test. Join @BenjaminHardman as he pushes the DJI Mavic 4 Pro through snow-covered peaks, shifting light, and sub-zero conditions to see how it truly performs in the wild.

From cinematic opening shots to real-world flight tests, this video breaks down every key moment:
00:00 - Cinematic reel
00:27 - First flight impressions in harsh weather
01:08 - Multi-focal length video & photo tests
04:48 - Low-light performance in Arctic conditions
06:58 - Vertical shooting and the Infinity Gimbal
08:40 - Final thoughts from a photographer’s perspective

With three focal lengths in one drone, Mavic 4 Pro offers exceptional creative freedom: a 4/3 CMOS Hasselblad main camera, a 70mm medium tele camera, and a 50MP tele camera. title: Hands-On Flagship Triple-Lens Camera Drone Review in Iceland | DJI Mavic 4 Pro

description:
From 2015 to 2025, every step forward has been powered by your passion for creation. Together, we’ve climbed higher, explored further, and captured the world in once impossible ways.

2025 marks another milestone across professional photography, drones, and action cameras—where technology meets imagination, and every moment becomes a story worth telling. Thank you for growing with DJI, for pushing boundaries, and for turning vision into reality.

Here’s to new peaks, new perspectives, and even more creative energy in the year ahead.

Which #DJI product or moment defined your journey with us? Share it in the comments.
